Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Marketing position at your company. As a junior digital marketer with a strong technical foundation in SEO, GEO, and web design, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to a team that values creativity, curiosity, and strategic thinking.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO for client websites, write keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra. I have also developed my own project, mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This hands-on experience has taught me the importance of ownership and experimentation, which aligns perfectly with your team's values.

I am eager to bring my skills in SEO, content, and analytics to your team, and to grow through the collaborative, feedback-driven environment you describe. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am comfortable working in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your projects.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Digital Marketing role at your company. Your emphasis on creativity, curiosity, and strategic thinking resonates deeply with my approach to digital marketing. I am a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), and I thrive in environments where ownership and experimentation are encouraged.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have taken full ownership of on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, resulting in improved organic visibility. I write keyword-targeted blog content that drives organic traffic, and I build and maintain client websites in WordPress using Elementor and the Astra theme. My daily work involves tracking performance with tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console, which has sharpened my analytical skills and my ability to make data-driven decisions.

Beyond my professional experience, I have developed mirook.com, a project where I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site for a Belgian youth chess champion. There, I implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to enhance visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project allowed me to experiment with GEO and AEO, and I have seen measurable improvements in search health scores.

I am particularly drawn to your team's belief in ownership and the freedom to try new approaches. I am eager to contribute to projects that have meaning and to grow through active feedback and cross-disciplinary collaboration. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and I work in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can contribute to your team. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
